import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { resetAndSeed } from '../support/seed';

// MUTATIVE REVERSAL: only one discount per invoice is allowed again. Stacked discounts collapse to
// a single discount, and the affordance to add another discount is gone. A single 10% discount on
// 200 shows $20.00 off for a total of $180.00, with no add-another control.
test.describe('single discount only', () => {
  test('one discount, no way to add another', { tag: '@core' }, async ({ page }) => {
    await resetAndSeed({
      clients: [{ id: 1, name: 'Acme Ltd', email: 'ops@acme.example' }],
      projects: [{ id: 1, name: 'Website Rebuild', clientId: 1 }],
      invoices: [{ id: 1, projectId: 1, status: 'DRAFT', discountPct: 10, lineItems: [{ id: 1, description: 'Work', qty: 1, unitPrice: 200 }] }],
    });
    await page.goto('/');
    await page.getByTestId('nav-projects').click();
    await page.getByTestId('project-open-1').click();
    await page.getByTestId('invoice-open-1').click();

    await expect(page.getByTestId('invoice-discount')).toHaveText('$20.00');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('invoice-amount')).toHaveText('$180.00');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('discount-add')).toHaveCount(0);
  });
});

-- An invoice can now carry several discounts at once, each either a percentage or a flat amount off what
-- its line items add up to. Their combined effect comes off before tax: the percentages each take their
-- share of the subtotal, then the flat amounts come off what is left (never more than is left).
CREATE TABLE invoice_discount (
    id              BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id      BIGINT         NOT NULL,
    discount_pct    DECIMAL(5, 2)  DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    discount_amount DECIMAL(12, 2) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_invoice_fk FOREIGN KEY (invoice_id) REFERENCES invoice (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_row_pct_range CHECK (discount_pct >= 0 AND discount_pct <= 100),
    CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_row_amount_non_negative CHECK (discount_amount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_row_one_kind CHECK (discount_pct = 0 OR discount_amount = 0),
    CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_row_not_empty CHECK (discount_pct > 0 OR discount_amount > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX invoice_discount_invoice_idx ON invoice_discount (invoice_id);

-- Each invoice's existing discount (only ever one kind) carries over as its single discount, so no
-- amounts change.
INSERT INTO invoice_discount (invoice_id, discount_pct, discount_amount)
SELECT id, discount_pct, discount_amount FROM invoice WHERE discount_pct > 0 OR discount_amount > 0;

ALTER TABLE invoice DROP CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_one_kind;
ALTER TABLE invoice DROP CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_pct_range;
ALTER TABLE invoice DROP CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_amount_non_negative;
ALTER TABLE invoice DROP COLUMN discount_pct;
ALTER TABLE invoice DROP COLUMN discount_amount;
-- A percentage discount can be capped at a maximum amount, so a large invoice never has more than that
-- taken off by it. Existing discounts have no cap, so their amounts are unchanged.

cd /home/daniel/ui-sandbox/src/main; cat > resources/db/migration/V112__single_invoice_discount.sql <<'EOF'
-- An invoice carries only one discount again. An invoice with several keeps what they took off together,
-- so its amount is unchanged: when they were all uncapped percentages they become one percentage (their
-- sum, never more than 100); otherwise they become one flat amount equal to what they took off between
-- them (the percentages' shares, each no more than its cap, plus the flat amounts, never more than the
-- subtotal).
CREATE VIEW invoice_discount_subtotal_v112 AS
    SELECT i.id AS invoice_id,
           COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ROUND(l.qty * l.unit_price, 2)
                         - ROUND(ROUND(l.qty * l.unit_price, 2) * l.discount_pct / 100, 2))
                     FROM invoice_line_item l WHERE l.invoice_id = i.id), 0) AS subtotal
    FROM invoice i
    WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_discount d WHERE d.invoice_id = i.id) > 1;

CREATE TABLE invoice_discount_v112 (
    invoice_id      BIGINT         NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    discount_pct    DECIMAL(5, 2)  NOT NULL,
    discount_amount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO invoice_discount_v112 (invoice_id, discount_pct, discount_amount)
SELECT s.invoice_id,
       CASE WHEN all_pct THEN LEAST(pct_sum, 100) ELSE 0 END,
       CASE WHEN all_pct THEN 0 ELSE LEAST(GREATEST(s.subtotal, 0), pct_taken + flat_sum) END
FROM (SELECT s.invoice_id,
             s.subtotal,
             NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_discount d WHERE d.invoice_id = s.invoice_id
                           AND (d.discount_pct = 0 OR d.discount_cap IS NOT NULL)) AS all_pct,
             (SELECT SUM(d.discount_pct) FROM invoice_discount d WHERE d.invoice_id = s.invoice_id) AS pct_sum,
             (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.discount_cap IS NULL THEN ROUND(s.subtotal * d.discount_pct / 100, 2)
                                       ELSE LEAST(ROUND(s.subtotal * d.discount_pct / 100, 2), d.discount_cap) END), 0)
              FROM invoice_discount d WHERE d.invoice_id = s.invoice_id AND d.discount_pct > 0) AS pct_taken,
             (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.discount_amount), 0) FROM invoice_discount d WHERE d.invoice_id = s.invoice_id) AS flat_sum
      FROM invoice_discount_subtotal_v112 s) s;

DELETE FROM invoice_discount WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_discount_v112);

-- An invoice whose discounts took nothing off (an empty invoice) is left with none.
INSERT INTO invoice_discount (invoice_id, discount_pct, discount_amount)
SELECT invoice_id, discount_pct, discount_amount FROM invoice_discount_v112
WHERE discount_pct > 0 OR discount_amount > 0;

DROP TABLE invoice_discount_v112;
DROP VIEW invoice_discount_subtotal_v112;

ALTER TABLE invoice_discount ADD CONSTRAINT invoice_discount_one_per_invoice UNIQUE (invoice_id);
EOF

content.text:
Each invoice now has at most one discount again, and there's no longer a way to add a second one. `bin/e2e` passes.

**Database** (`V112__single_invoice_discount.sql`): invoices that had several discounts are merged into one, and the amount taken off stays the same:
- If they were all uncapped percentages, they become one percentage (their sum, capped at 100).
- Otherwise they become one flat amount equal to what they took off together, never more than the subtotal.

A unique constraint on `invoice_discount(invoice_id)` now enforces one discount per invoice. The e2e run only applied this migration to an empty database. So I also ran it against stacked sample data in H2, and it gave the expected results: 10% + 5% became 15%; 10% + $30 on $200 became $50 off; a capped 50% plus $500 became $200 off; an invoice with a single discount was left as it was.

**Server:**
- Removed the "add a discount" and "remove a discount" endpoints (`POST …/discounts` and `DELETE …/discounts/{id}`) and their service and model methods.
- `PUT …/discount` sets the invoice's one discount; zero removes it. It now updates the existing discount instead of deleting it and inserting a new one. That was necessary because Hibernate writes inserts before deletes, which would break the new unique constraint.
- New invoices pick up the client's default discount the same way.
- The test seed endpoint now rejects a fixture with more than one discount (HTTP 400).

**Front end:** I removed the "Add as another discount" button and the list of separate discounts, including each one's Remove button. The single Discount row shows the percentage or the flat amount, plus the cap if there is one.

**Removed `data-testid`s:** CLAUDE.md says never to remove an existing `data-testid`, but these belonged only to the stacking UI this change takes out: `discount-form-add`, `discount-row-{id}`, `discount-row-label`, `discount-row-amount`, `discount-row-remove` and `breakdown-discount-row-{id}`. Any older tests that use them will need updating. `discount-row-cap` is kept and now sits on the main Discount row. All other discount `data-testid`s (`invoice-discount`, `invoice-discount-pct`, `invoice-discount-amount` and the `discount-form-*` fields) are unchanged.

The API response still includes the `discounts` list, now always with zero or one entry, so other code that reads it keeps working.

All other discount `data-testid`s (`invoice-discount`, `invoice-discount-pct`, `invoice-discount-amount` and the `discount-form-*` fields) are unchanged.

The API response still includes the `discounts` list, now always with zero or one entry, so other code that reads it keeps working.
